block_percent_witness.note: Player::GetBlockPercent returns a fraction (Player.cpp:26822-26831) that CalculatePct treats as a percent (Unit.cpp:1459) and that the spell path truncates to uint32 0 (Unit.cpp:1239); the virtual base returns 30.0f for every non-player (Unit.h:987). Consumer fact, trinity-probe verified; not a Retail claim.

glancing.condition: attacker player or pet, victim creature non-pet, attackerLevel + 3 < victimLevel (Unit.cpp:2455-2464); no cap on (10 + 10 * diff) * 100 despite the 40% comment
glancing.current_input: needs a creature level >= 94 against a level-90 player: ContentTuning with MaxLevel 90 plus LevelScalingDeltaMax >= 4 (Creature.cpp:3060-3075, 3130-3160). The nine encounters of JournalInstance 1317/1320 (maps 2987/3004) are absent from TDB 1200.26021, so their delta is unknown to Trinity.

provenance.note: schema-driven restricted replay; see tools/tdb_replay.py. Rows are Trinity authoring for the pinned TDB, not client data and not Retail truth.

level_census.model: level = clamp(player_level, CT.MinLevel(+type adj), CT.MaxLevel(+type adj)) + LevelScalingDeltaMax (upper end of the irand range); glancing (player attacker) and crushing eligibility (creature attacker) both need level >= player_level + 4; ConditionalContentTuning redirects and MaxCreatureScalingLevel / ScalingPlayerLevelDelta are ignored (assumption)

glancing.reopen: a current (ExpansionID 11) creature_template_difficulty row whose level vs a level-90 player is >= 94; current raid bosses are absent from the pinned TDB (build-skew)

crushing.condition: attackerLevel >= victimLevel + 4, attacker not player-controlled, no CREATURE_FLAG_EXTRA_NO_CRUSHING_BLOWS (Unit.cpp:2481-2494)
crushing.current_input: eligibility needs the same +4 creature as glancing; even then tmp = attackerLevel - victimLevel * 1000 - 1500 (Unit.cpp:2489) is negative, and because every earlier band already failed `roll < sum`, `roll < sum + tmp` is false for every roll: crushing is unselectable for any attackerLevel < victimLevel * 1000 + 1500
crushing.reopen: a TrinityCore change to Unit.cpp:2489 (precedence) together with a +4 creature
